name: sportsclub-html
description: Sports club template — lineup on the pitch by formation where a suspended or injured player cannot start, suspensions derived from the match sheets, a league table with tie-breakers applied in order, court booking with conflict detection and weekly caps, and member dues that gate booking. Free, MIT, no backend.

paragraphs: An amateur football club with both of its sides, built with plain HTML, vanilla JavaScript and Tailwind CSS v4: the public site that is the face of the club and the back room where the coaching staff and the front office work. Supporters get the squad, the league table, the fixture list, the match sheet of every round and the membership form. The staff get a pitch where the lineup is picked by formation, a match sheet that feeds everything else, the championship, the pitch bookings and the monthly fee. No framework, no runtime bundler — one .html file per screen and a handful of classic…

Five rules carry the template, and none of them is a stored field. Suspensions are derived from the match sheets in round order — three yellows means one match banned and the counter resets, a red is one match and a straight red is two — so recording a card changes who can be picked for the next round. The lineup refuses an unavailable player and says exactly why, while an out-of-position player goes in with a warning.
